solo.name: Solo
solo.tagline: One character. Three bots. One pull.
solo.blurb: The raid game as it is normally played: you are responsible for one job, and you have to trust — or work around — the three priority lists standing next to you.

gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
gauntlet.tagline: Three pulls. Damage carries. It gets worse.
gauntlet.blurb: A run, not a pull. Kill him three times without a rest: your health carries between stages, the pit rolls a new modifier each time, and you pick one Quake pickup between rounds to keep for the rest of the run.

drill.name: Drill
drill.tagline: One mechanic, on repeat, until you drop.
drill.blurb: Practice. Pick a single mechanic and it comes at you over and over with nothing else going on. He cannot be killed and you are not trying to — the score is how many you survive cleanly.

commander.name: Commander
commander.tagline: You drive all four. Tactical pause.
commander.blurb: Nobody runs a priority list — every ability of every character is yours. F1–F4 or a click switches who you are commanding, and the fight pauses itself whenever something happens that you would want to react to.

gambit.name: Gambit
gambit.tagline: You write the priority lists, then watch.
gambit.blurb: You do not play the fight at all — you program the four bots and press pull, and you can run hundreds of headless pulls of a build before you watch a single one.
